name: How can I make my bathroom more energy-efficient?

mainEntity.name: How can I make my bathroom more energy-efficient?

acceptedAnswer.text: To enhance energy efficiency, consider several upgrades during your renovation. Install low-flow toilets and showerheads to significantly reduce water consumption without sacrificing performance. Opt for LED lighting fixtures, which use less electricity and have a longer lifespan than traditional bulbs. Energy-efficient exhaust fans are crucial for removing moisture, preventing mold, and reducing the need for heating/cooling. Upgrading to an on-demand tankless water heater can also save energy by heating water only when needed, rather than continuously storing it.
acceptedAnswer.description: Install low-flow toilets and showerheads, LED lighting, energy-efficient exhaust fans, and potentially a tankless water heater to boost efficiency.
